name: STI-244GP-BT.doc
method: soffice→docx→python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Model	STI-244GP-BT
Product Name	6 port 10/100/1000Mbps Industrial PoE Switch
Fixed Port	4*10/100/1000M RJ45 PoE port / 2*1000M SFP
PoE Ports	1 port supports IEEE802.3af/at/poe++/bt, with a maximum power of 90W per port / 2-4 ports support IEEE802.3af/at, with a maximum single port power of 30W
PoE Budget	180W
PoE Pin	af/at: 12+ 36- / af/at/poe++/bt: 12+ 45+ 36- 78-
Transmission Mode	Store and Forward
Bandwidth	16Gbps
Packet Forwarding	11.9Mpps
MAC	4K
Buffer	2.5M
DIP Switch	1: Light mouthed watchdog / 2: PoE Watchdog / 3: 1-4 port ultra long mode 250 meters (10M) / 4: After opening the ports, ports 1-4 are isolated from each other and cannot be accessed between them. They can only be accessed from the uplink port
Port Specification	10/100/1000BaseT(X)Auto
Transmission Mode	Store and Forward(full wire-speed）
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T: Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX: Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter) / 1000BASE-TX: Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter)
Optical Media	SFP: 1000M single and multimode optical module, Max distance≤100Km
LED Indicator	PWR: Power indicator light / P1: Power indicator light / P2: Power indicator light / PMX: Power overload indicator light / 5,6: Optical port connection indicator light / Port orange indicator light: PoE indicator light / Port green indicator light: Link indicator light
Power input	V1: 37-57V 5A MAX / V2: 37-57V 5A MAX / IN: --
Operating Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+75°C / 10%～90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+85°C / 5%～95% RH No condensation
Dimension / L*W*H	Device: 155mm*115mm*40mm / Packing Box: 235mm*165mm*78mm
N.W/G.W(Kg)	0.9Kg/1.1Kg
Lightning / Protection Level	6KV 8/20us; 8KV ESD electrostatic protection / IP40
Installation	Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368 / FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
Warranty	3 Years
